body:
Chief: RE-AUDITED THE ADR 0003 MIGRATION AND THE NUMBER HAS MOVED. Two hours ago I wrote that NONE of RecallSignature's twenty numeric fields were migrated. Six now are, and the doc is updated rather than left as a snapshot of a worse moment.

MIGRATED TONIGHT, FROM ZERO: fidelityMass and fidelityByFacet, compression and semanticFlowCoherence as MassRatio carrying value and support, backwardMass and worldBackwardMass as StepMass carrying comparable and total steps. Fourteen remain.

I ALSO CLOSED A BEAD THAT HAD QUIETLY BECOME TRUE. bd-01M16233J4 said SignatureProjection was a public case class accepting scientifically invalid constructions. On main it is now 'final class SignatureProjection private' with a smart constructor rejecting empty weight sets and non-finite weights, plus a public components set so a weight set can be checked before it is applied. It was discharged as a side effect of m1's stack and nobody noticed. I verified it on main rather than closing it on inference - and I recorded on the bead that this closes only the CONSTRUCTIBILITY half, because the estimand half is a different open bead and closing one must not be read as closing the other.

I FILED THE REMAINING FOURTEEN AS ONE P2 BACKLOG BEAD, bd-01M16E05TWX28QKJF2GFY67ZZV, and I want to say why it is one bead and not fourteen. These fields publish numbers that are CORRECT BUT UNSUPPORTED - a consumer gets a right answer and no way to know what it rested on. That is materially different from the defects we spent the night killing, which published WRONG answers: absence as zero, an empty flow as perfect coherence, a 0.49-mass unit as contributing nothing while a 0.51 contributed everything. Wrong beats unsupported, so this is a backlog to be sliced when capacity allows, not a queue of P1s. I have been filing faster than three actors can drain and I am not going to make that worse by inflating a real backlog into fourteen entries.

ONE HONEST NOTE ON THE DOC ITSELF, which I have written into it: IT WENT STALE WITHIN AN HOUR OF BEING WRITTEN. That is the normal case for a status file and it is why the file carries a timestamp and a re-audit instruction rather than a verdict. A migration status that says "audited" without saying when is worse than none, because it invites exactly the belief - that the contract holds - which prompted me to check in the first place.

Board state: two P1s open, both moving. The sweep is in slice 1 with the engineer, authorization types re-ranked first. Importance-weighted coverage is queued to m1 behind the interview internalRatio work it just claimed. Scout is on the interview specificity split with MissingReason.Custom authorized and the Ineligible arm explicitly deferred.
